title: external_agency_document
description: Documents from outside agencies or vendors that are not investigation reports: government notices, inspection certificates, contractor estimates, invoices, utility or weather records.

issuing_agency.description: Agency, company, or office that issued the document.

document_purpose.description: Why the document exists (notice, estimate, certificate, invoice, record request, etc.).

key_determinations.description: Decisions, determinations, or conclusions stated in the document.

amounts.description: Monetary amounts stated in the document.
